summary: Fontwerk's black-and-white page for Neue DIN, a 243-style variable reboot of DIN (wdth 50–200, wght 100–900, slnt -10–10 with a backslanted 'Retalic'). Grainy macro footage of cast letter surfaces alternates with hover-reactive specimens: a pointer-driven hero with a live axis readout, a 9×9 design-space GIF, script tabs, condensed charset marquees, a width×weight matrix, a fact list, a cycling OpenType-feature glyph and a three-slider tester. Fixed rotated corner links (PDF Specimen, Buy, Fontwerk, Try) frame every screen.

instances.look: Full-screen grainy black-and-white macro footage of a cast letter's surface, 'Neue DIN' in white at ~200px in the centre, a tiny condensed readout 'WIDTH: 088, WEIGHT: 500, SLANT: 0.00' top-centre and rotated corner links FONTWERK, TRY, PDF SPECIMEN, BUY
instances.ux: Moving the mouse anywhere on the page changes the name's width, weight and slant and updates the readout; the name is editable; on phones a 'Request orientation permission' overlay lets device tilt drive the axes
instances.learn: Echo the live axis values in a small readout above the name: a pointer-driven hero then explains itself without sliders

reconstruction.behaviour: body onmousemove → showCoords maps pointer x/y to wdth/wght (and slnt) on #txt_title_ID and writes 'Width: 088, Weight: 500, Slant: 0.00' into #txt_subheadline_ID; DeviceOrientation on mobile after a permission button (#permission_ID); background video loops; corner link colours flip on scroll (changeNavColor)
